Worst Experience With Pentobarbitone
Once, when I was the assistant of a vet doctor, I took a bit of pentobarbital solution. I was used to euthanasia, but I added water to it, I calculate the dose and shot it.
Firstly all my nervousness gone, but I was like if I was drunk. I couldn't walk straight, talk clearly etc. After 50 minutes, the effect gone, and I felt terrible.  I had headache, I vomited, etc. I dont recommend this to anyone.
